subject.title: fix(sessions): persist sender metadata in user turn transcript JSONL

question: Should OpenClaw persist senderId, senderName, and senderUsername, while excluding senderE164, in durable group/channel session JSONL via this recorder plumbing?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the remaining choice changes durable local identity state and touches an SDK-visible session method, which requires maintainer intent rather than an automated repair verdict.

options.title: Approve Bounded Sender Metadata
options.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername as durable group/channel transcript metadata and keep phone-number identity excluded.

options.title: Narrow Or Internalize First
options.body: Ask for reduced stored fields or move the recorder handoff behind a non-public internal seam before merge.

options.title: Pause For Fresh Live Proof
options.body: Require a latest-head redacted live Telegram group run showing the JSONL envelope and senderE164 omission before deciding.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Sender Metadata
recommendation.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername as durable group/channel transcript metadata and keep phone-number identity excluded.
